long1: VART Soluções is an Angolan technical services company. It starts from plumbing and hydraulic systems — installations, pumping, swimming pools and maintenance — and also works in electrical installation and finishing such as tiling, false ceilings and painting, on building jobs and installations.
long2: Every job is run with technical care: careful diagnosis, suitable materials, clean execution and a final check — because the quality of an installation is not seen on day one, but over the years.
